name: Customer Portal

fields.label: Issuing Company (grower)
fields.description: The grower entity the portal is issued by (Constancy once live).

fields.label: Customer Name
fields.description: The name the customer sees on the portal (from the Customer).

fields.label: Customer
fields.description: The ERPNext Customer this portal is for — a buyer, packer or first handler.

fields.label: Role
fields.description: What the customer is to the fruit. A first handler / first receiver gets the FSMA 204 lot records.

fields.label: Season
fields.description: YYYY — what the share shows by default.

fields.label: Export Markets
fields.description: One per line (US, Canada, Japan, Korea, Taiwan, EU …): MRL status is shown for these.

description: v0.313.0. A read-only portal for one customer that buys, packs or first-handles the fruit (Orchard View, Monson, PFI, a future buyer): only the blocks committed to it and the lots and deliveries that went to it. Never costs, prices, labour, people or HR. Was Packer Share (v0.276.0).
